# Mermaid Code

> A desktop Mermaid diagram editor built for AI-first workflows on macOS and Windows. Diagrams live as plain `.mmd` / `.mermaid` files on your local filesystem — edit side-by-side with the built-in Claude Code or Codex sidebar, connect external AI agents via the built-in MCP server, and see live SVG previews update automatically when files change on disk. Free, open-source, and 100% local (no cloud sync, no telemetry).

- [Homepage](https://mermaid-code.com/): Product overview, AI workflow, MCP setup, and installation

## Install

Direct latest installers (auto-updates once installed):
- macOS (Apple Silicon): https://releases.mermaid-code.com/latest/Mermaid.Code_aarch64.dmg
- macOS (Intel): https://releases.mermaid-code.com/latest/Mermaid.Code_x64.dmg
- Windows (x64 .exe): https://releases.mermaid-code.com/latest/Mermaid.Code_x64-setup.exe
- Windows (x64 .msi): https://releases.mermaid-code.com/latest/Mermaid.Code_x64_en-US.msi
- Linux (experimental, untested): https://releases.mermaid-code.com/latest/Mermaid.Code_amd64.deb / https://releases.mermaid-code.com/latest/Mermaid.Code-1.x86_64.rpm

Homebrew (macOS):
```sh
brew tap m8524769/tap
brew install --cask mermaid-code
```

macOS first-launch note: The app is unsigned. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**, or run:
```sh
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Mermaid Code.app"
```

## Built-in MCP Server

Enable inside Mermaid Code via **Menu → MCP Server**. It listens on `http://localhost:37079/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, no Node.js or Python required).

Available tools:
- `list_diagrams`: Returns the opened folder, list of `.mmd` files, and the active tab.
- `preview_diagram`: Previews generated Mermaid code in the Draft tab without writing to disk.
- `search_icons`: Resolves concepts (e.g. `"postgres"`, `"kubernetes"`) to exact built-in icon names (`logos:`, `fas:`, `far:`, `fab:`) that render offline.

Client configurations:
- Claude Code (`~/.claude.json`): `claude mcp add --transport http --scope user mermaid-code-mcp http://localhost:37079/mcp`
- Codex (`~/.codex/config.toml`): `codex mcp add mermaid-code-mcp --url http://localhost:37079/mcp`
- OpenCode (`~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`): `opencode mcp add mermaid-code-mcp --url http://localhost:37079/mcp --global`
- Hermes (`~/.hermes/config.yaml`):
  ```yaml
  mcp_servers:
    mermaid-code-mcp:
      url: "http://localhost:37079/mcp"
  ```
- Antigravity (`~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json`):
  ```json
  {
    "mcpServers": {
      "mermaid-code-mcp": {
        "url": "http://localhost:37079/mcp"
      }
    }
  }
  ```

## Key Capabilities

- **AI-first workflow**: Built-in Claude Code and Codex sidebar with per-folder session history and inline follow-up questions; automatic preview reload when external agents modify files on disk (preserving pan/zoom).
- **Local file manager**: Open any folder as a file tree or live SVG thumbnail grid with subfolder filtering, drag & drop, OS "Open with" support for `.mmd` / `.mermaid`, multi-tab restore per folder, auto-save, and quit guard.
- **Editor & styling**: Syntax highlighting for all Mermaid diagram types, diagram-aware keyword autocomplete, click-to-edit inline color swatches, Vim mode, visual config panel (theme, look, layout, font) with **Pin to code**, and built-in offline icon packs (SVG Logos & Font Awesome).
